macro_assessment.regime_name: Bear Steepening / Fiscal Dominance & Sticky Inflation
macro_assessment.regime_summary: Long-end yields (10Y testing ~5.0%, 30Y at ~5.33%) are under pressure from heavy Treasury coupon supply ($2T deficit) and persistent inflation (CPI at 3.4%). The 10Y term premium has climbed to ~1.02%, while 2Y (~4.38%) is relatively well-anchored by the restrictive Fed rate range.
macro_assessment.executive_paragraph: Maintain an Overweight on the 5Y Belly (Top Pick) and 2Y Carry, paired with a DV01-neutral 2s10s / 2s30s Steepener trade, while Underweighting 30Y long-end duration. This strategy locks in ~4.78% yield with modest duration volatility as heavy Treasury coupon issuance ($2T deficit) and sticky CPI (3.4%) push 10Y term premiums higher (~1.02%). What triggers a pivot to Long Duration (Bull Flattening)? A decisive daily close of the 10Y yield below 4.70% (50d/200d SMA support zone), accompanied by 2s10s breaking below +25 bps and unemployment rising above 4.6%, would invalidate the supply-steepening thesis and mandate an immediate rotation into 10Y and 30Y duration.

curve_trade_recommendation.primary_trade: 2s10s / 2s30s Curve Steepener (Long Front / Short Long Duration)

2y.rationale: High ~4.38% yield with minimal duration risk (DV01 $19/bp). Insulated from sovereign deficit supply shocks.

5y.rationale: Captures 4.78% yield (90% of 30Y yield) with only 28% of the duration volatility. Optimal roll-down along the steepest part of the curve.

10y.rationale: Yield near 5.0% is historically attractive, but vulnerable to auction tails and corporate refinancing headwinds.

30y.rationale: Extreme duration risk (DV01 $165/bp). Heavily exposed to expanding term premiums, $40T national debt debate, and continuous Treasury auction supply.

headlines.title: 10-Year Yield Tests 5.0% Benchmark Ceiling as Deficit Issuance Weighs on Auction Absorption
headlines.takeaway: Heavy government borrowing ($2T annual coupon supply) pushes 30Y yields to near two-decade highs while 10Y tests the critical 5.00% psychological barrier. Term premium expansion (+1.02%) dominates duration pricing.

headlines.title: Bond Vigilantes Put Fed in Policy Box as Yield Curve Back-End Resists Easing Impulses
headlines.takeaway: Persistent energy price pressures and sovereign debt supply prevent long-end yields from tracking policy rate cuts. Curve steepening (2s10s at +58 bps) becomes the primary macro adjustment mechanism.

headlines.title: Treasury Buyback Program Deployed to Cushion Back-End Liquidity Against Record Supply
headlines.takeaway: Treasury conducts tactical coupon repurchases to support off-the-run liquidity, but structural budget deficits keep primary dealer balance sheets constrained.

headlines.title: The Belly of the Beast: Why Intermediate 5-Year Treasuries Offer the Ultimate Risk-Reward Buffer
headlines.takeaway: Yielding ~4.78%, the 5Y tenor delivers 90% of the 30Y yield while carrying just 28% of the duration volatility. Ideal roll-down vehicle along the steep front slope.

regimes.name: Bull Steepening
regimes.macro_driver: Recession Shock / Aggressive Fed Easing Cycle
regimes.curve_motion: Front-end yields plummet faster than long-end yields. 2s10s widens dramatically.
regimes.rationale: Front-end catches the entire magnitude of emergency Fed rate cuts. 5Y belly captures huge price rally.

regimes.name: Bull Flattening
regimes.macro_driver: Late-Cycle Disinflation / Peak Fed Rates to Growth Deceleration
regimes.curve_motion: Long-end yields drop significantly while short rates remain anchored or decline slowly.
regimes.worst_point: 2Y (yield drop is constrained by current policy rate)
regimes.rationale: High duration multiplies capital gains. As long-term inflation fears dissolve, 30Y duration produces stellar double-digit returns.

regimes.name: Bear Flattening
regimes.macro_driver: Hawkish Tightening / Inflation Shock / Fed Policy Surprise
regimes.curve_motion: Front-end yields spike violently as rate hike bets surge. Curve inverts.
regimes.rationale: Capital preservation is paramount. Ultra-short paper captures rising coupon reinvestment with zero duration loss.

regimes.name: Bear Steepening (Current Regime)
regimes.macro_driver: Reflation / Fiscal Dominance / Sovereign Debt Issuance Shock
regimes.curve_motion: Long-end yields surge due to term premium expansion and auction indigestion while 2Y is anchored.
regimes.best_trades: Curve Steepener (Short 30Y vs Long 2Y/5Y), Belly Carry
regimes.rationale: Avoid long duration. Front-to-belly locks in high income (>4.4%-4.8%) with low volatility, while 30Y suffers severe drawdown.

framework_rules.tactical_rule: If yield trades near Technical Band boundaries (Bollinger/RSI >70 or <30), take a tactical short-term position (0.05y to 0.10y duration contribution).
framework_rules.strategic_rule: If yield trades near Fundamental Fair Value Band boundaries, take a longer-term strategic position (0.10y to 0.15y duration contribution).
framework_rules.confluence_rule: If yield is aligned near BOTH Technical and Fundamental boundaries in the same direction, execute a BIGGER POSITION (0.20y to 0.25y duration contribution).
framework_rules.stop_loss_rule: Every trade recommendation carries a mandatory hard stop loss level and live mark-to-market P&L tracking.
